svg.aria-label: Left: the global water cycle, atmosphere, rain, ground and river, ocean, with a total that stays about the same. Right: a zoom into one dry basin where a data centre withdraws from the shared aquifer, river or reservoir and evaporates some of it, which is consumed locally even though the rain falls somewhere else, some time later.
svg.text: THE PLANET KEEPS ITS WATER. A TOWN CAN STILL RUN DRY.
consumptive use: water evaporated or otherwise removed from the immediate water environment (USGS)
